column1: # PSR-E343 Drum Kit List, extracted from the official Yamaha Owner's Manual psre343_en_om_b0.pdf, pages 53-55.
# midi_note = the note number on MIDI (what the app sends); keyboard_note = MIDI + 12 (the E343 panel keyboard, per the manual footnote). Note names use Yamaha C3 = 60.
# same_as_std1 = blank cell in the manual ("same as Standard Kit 1"). Notes not listed for a kit have no sound in that kit.

# same_as_std1=footnote_only (kits 199-205, page 55): the cell is blank and the footnote on page 53 says blank = same as Standard Kit 1, but page 55 does not show Standard Kit 1 beside these kits; treat as UNVERIFIED until heard on the instrument.
# SFX Kit 1/2 (203, 204): the manual says their actual KEYBOARD notes are one octave lower than listed; midi_note is given as listed.
# MERGED CELL in 205 Sound Effect Kit: 'Drum Loop' is printed across the rows between MIDI notes 29 and 30; the manual does not state the exact keys, so no note row is claimed for it.
# MERGED CELL in 205 Sound Effect Kit: 'Huuaah!' is printed across the rows between MIDI notes 65 and 66; the manual does not state the exact keys, so no note row is claimed for it.
